The severe underpredictions for m72, m94, m117, m178, m159, m146, and related rows strengthen the delayed-tail and basic-topology hypotheses. The m73 measurements, including the unusual strong-eluent point, support abrupt scaffold-specific transitions. The new batch therefore emphasizes measured failure families while adding matched loading or ratio points and chemically distinct controls.","batch_rationale":"The batch repairs several dominant failure regions: delayed V2 tails in aldehydes, nitro compounds, dicarbonyls, and aromatic carbonyls; high-retention basic and donor-rich systems; and loading-dependent errors. Paired m73 and m72 choices create local condition-response experiments, while m160, m161, m141, m146, m216, and m209 probe whether basic-topology failures generalize across related structures. The m94, m125, m193, m198, m204, m107, m114, and m128 choices extend endpoint-tail supervision across different substitution patterns and loading contexts. Neutral ketone, ether, halogenated, ester, and polyether controls prevent the retrained model from turning these observations into universal offsets. Together, the batch covers high-error Row regions, tests interpolation between measured conditions, and supplies chemically distinct anchors that should improve V1/V2 generalization across the full catalog."}
